svg.title: The Attached Workcell: FluffyJaws Dev Studio as one machine
svg.desc: An instrument bench on four feet. In its rack a console with a paper-tape readout stands beside a terminal; three small satellite modules are cabled back to the console; a motor turns a flywheel; a CRT on a swivel post faces out past the end of the bench; a chute feeds sheets into an output tray; a mailbox raises a flag; a locked drawer with a combination dial sits in the bench front; and a blue cartridge in a dock is tethered down to a separate granite surface plate standing on its own feet beside the bench.
